items.quote: as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing
items.claim: When Moses came near the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing.
items.action: came near the camp and saw

items.claim: Moses became very angry when he saw the calf and the dancing.
items.mechanism: The text says his anger followed right after he saw the calf and the dancing ('as soon as... he saw'), so seeing them is what set it off.

items.quote: he cast the tables out of his hands
items.claim: Moses threw the tables out of his hands.
items.mechanism: The throwing is joined to his anger by 'and' in the text, which suggests the anger led to it.

items.quote: and brake them beneath the mount
items.claim: Moses broke the tables at the foot of the mount.
items.mechanism: The tables broke as part of the same angry throw.
